CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
are
renting
an
apartment
,
but
there
are
some
problems
with
it
.
You
are
writing
an
email
to
the
building
manager
owner
to
complain
that
the
neighbors
are
noisy
and
the
hot
water
system
is
not
well
.
And
it's
not
the
first
time
that
the
hot
water
system
is
not
well
.
You
are
writing
an
email
to
Marvin
,
the
owner
of
the
building
,
to
solve
this
problem
.
You
should
write
between
80
and
120
words
.
You
should
include
:
What
problems
you
have
encountered
;
How
you
are
affected
;
How
to
fix
the
problems
.
